content: React + Canvas multiplayer pattern: client is a 'dumb renderer' — HTML5 Canvas with requestAnimationFrame render loop redraws entities from latest received state; WebSocket client (native WebSocket API or a thin wrapper) receives typed messages (playerJoined, stateUpdate, playerLeft) and updates local state store (useState/useRef or Zustand) outside the React re-render cycle for performance; input capture (keydown/keyup or pointer) sends input messages to server, does not mutate authoritative state directly.
